items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Maurice Graff only in a parenthetical note, with no personal interaction or relationship described between the interviewee (Teddy McRae) and Maurice Graff.

ctx.x: Just like the trumpet -- the teacher that Cat Anderson studied with. The guy told Cat Anderson, "You stay with me, I'll make you the greatest trumpet player in the business." And he did.
I say, "Cat stayed with that man." He was teaching him non-pressure. When Cat come out, he could hit the 5 C's. You hear them all.
